title: Nice shag bathroom rug!
text: Nice shag bathroom rug!. I really like this Ouka bath mat. It is soft and plush and I love the old school shag feel to it. The blue color is a deep color and blends perfectly in my guest bath. I have washed it only once since I had it, I did it separately just because of the dark blue color. It did not fade and looks as vibrant as it did when I took it out of the bag. Nice inexpensive rug for a great look and feel.
